lastCompletedStory.title: Judgment point: park the drain and escalate on a blocked cycle

nextStoryContext: US-005 is done. The auto-dispatcher (makeProductionMetaLoopDispatchFn in src/commands/sidecar.ts) now has a blocked-cycle judgment point: when prd.json is present with review.lastVerdict === 'MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT', handleBlockedCycleBoundary emits a 'meta-loop-dispatch {blockedCycle:true}' event once (deduped via ctx.blockedCycleEmitted) and fires blockedCycleEscalateFn (Resend) or warnFn (soft-warn) best-effort. The sidecar loop keeps polling (no SIGTERM, no clearActive). The block resets when prd.json is absent (operator ship/abandon). BLOCKED_CYCLE_ESCALATE_SUBJECT is exported from sidecar.ts. The MetaLoopDispatchEventDetail in events.ts has a new '{ blockedCycle: true }' variant. All 3166 tests pass. The file-size ratchet was raised for sidecar.ts (1458->1558), events.ts (440->444), and the test file (984->1282).

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-005 touches only project-internal modules (sidecar.ts dispatch logic, events.ts types, and test file). The sendEscalation reuse calls an existing project wrapper; no new external library API was exercised.
